text:
aly: Quick design sync thread for tomorrow's compare-table review. Problem: pinned versions are getting lost when users toggle compact/dense view + collapse rows. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/model-compare-pin-ideas :mag:

ben: Noticed that — if you pin a variant then switch to compact the pin icon is offscreen or hidden behind the collapse chevron. Users told us in research they expected an always-visible marker.

chandra: Two lightweight patterns to consider: 1) small persistent pin left-of-name (logical gutter) 2) on-collapse label inline like "Pinned: v3" 3) floating micro-toolbar at the top that lists pinned models. I like (1) for discoverability, (2) for clarity, (3) for low-clutter.

omar: For dense rows the floating toolbar is appealing because it doesn't add width to rows. But discoverability is the worry. We could animate the first pin creation so users notice the strip.

zoe: Accessibility notes: pin must be reachable by keyboard (tab) and have aria-pressed true/false with aria-label="Toggle pin for side-by-side compare". Also badges: current "good"/"fair" color tokens fail 4.5 at 12px — need contrast tokens or text fallback.

aly: Microcopy proposal: tooltips should say "Keep model visible in compare" instead of "Pin version". Short and non-technical. Also badge tooltip header: "Latency · Cost" and show the numbers split.

ben: Edge-case: when you pin then apply a filter that excludes it, we should show a non-blocking banner: "Pinned model hidden by filters. [Show pinned]" so you can reveal it without undoing filters.

chandra: Implementation constraints: gutter pin is easiest visually but requires absolute positioning to avoid changing column layout. Better to render as an overlay inside the row container. Also ensure hit target >= 32px.

omar: Keyboard shortcut idea: while a row is focused, press P to toggle pin. Make sure we prevent conflicts with browser shortcuts. Example aria snippet:

```
<button class="pin-btn" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Toggle pin for side-by-side compare">📌</button>
```

Space/Enter toggles it.

zoe: For colorblind users, don't rely on color alone for perf badges. Add a small icon (⚡ for low latency, 🧮 for cost) or initials (L/M/H). Also include sr-only strings like "Latency 23ms" so screen readers get the values.

aly: UX decision proposal: default to gutter pin + collapsed inline label fallback, with optional floating strip for power users (opt-in when >2 pins). We'll prototype both and run quick 5-person tests.

ben: Metric plan: track pin.interaction (method: click|keyboard|shortcut), pin.visibility (gutter|inline|strip), and reveal-by-filter actions. We'll need these to pick a default.

chandra: QA checklist: - pin control has aria-pressed - tooltip copy updated - badges meet contrast or have text fallback - pinned persistence toggle implemented - keyboard "P" works when row focused.

ux-bot: Created ticket PC-9901: "Compare: pin affordance variants + badges contrast + keyboard flows" and attached Figma frames.

product-ops: Added ACs and assigned to eng-frontend: 1) Persistent pin visible in collapsed and compact modes; 2) Option to keep pinned rows visible when filtering; 3) Badges meet 4.5:1 or show icon/text fallback; 4) Analytics events emitted for pin flows; 5) i18n overflow checks for inline label.

omar: I'll mock two prototypes today (gutter+inline label, gutter+floating strip) and include keyboard flows and RTL samples. Drop links here when ready.

aly: Thanks — please ping me when prototypes are up. Demo in design review tomorrow. :thumbsup:
